name: Poterjannoe zavtra
source:
Ichiro is by no means your average high school student. He never accepted the norms of society, is indifferent to the feelings of other people and is completely irresponsible. Who would have thought that literally the next morning Ichiro would remain the last person on Earth? 

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-421]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
一郎绝不是普通的高中生。他从不接受社会规范，对他人的感受漠不关心，完全不负责任。谁能想到，就在第二天早晨，一郎竟成了地球上最后一个人？

[翻译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-421]Anivisual[/url]]
